name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Growing up in Johannesburg, she initially pursued a degree in engineering, finding a fascination with fluid dynamics that led her to Formula Student. After graduating, she spent several years honing her skills in wind tunnel testing and CFD analysis for a small racing outfit. Her meticulous approach and sharp eye for detail quickly earned her a reputation as a reliable and innovative aero specialist.

Her philosophy centers around a holistic understanding of the car. She believes that aerodynamic development isn't just about maximizing downforce; it's about creating a balanced and predictable platform that inspires driver confidence. Thandiwe is known for her collaborative approach, fostering open communication between the aero department and other engineering teams. She is also committed to mentoring young engineers, ensuring that her passion for motorsport is passed on to the next generation.

What sets Thandiwe apart is her unwavering dedication and ability to find creative solutions under pressure. She has a knack for identifying subtle aerodynamic improvements that others often overlook. Her experience and drive make her a valuable asset to any team seeking a competitive edge.

physical.description: Thandiwe is a woman of medium build with a warm, engaging smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Insists on listening to classical music while working in the wind tunnel.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
